profile_text.body:
Zebra Technologies Corp. describes itself as "The World's Foundation for Intelligent Operations." On its website, the company says it powers intelligent operations to digitize, automate, and enhance processes with mobile computers, scanners, printers, RFID, and more. It also presents manufacturing technology solutions that include hardware and software for automation, data analysis, and factory connectivity.

The company's AI-related offerings include Zebra Companion AI, which it says offers instant, tailored insights and support for frontline operations; Zebra Frontline AI Enablers, described as AI vision models, sample apps, and APIs that streamline workflows; and Zebra Frontline AI Blueprints, presented as adaptable, real-world AI frameworks for automating manual tasks. Zebra also offers the Aurora suite of machine vision software for track-and-trace, vision inspection, and industrial automation, and Aurora Focus for controlling fixed industrial scanners and machine vision smart cameras. The company describes its AI as an intelligent and open platform built to integrate with RFID, enterprise software, and machine vision.

Zebra Technologies Corp. is a public company headquartered in Lincolnshire, Illinois, trading under the ticker ZBRA and registered with the SEC under CIK 0000877212. Illinois records list 374 legal exposure entries for the company.
